# Experten efter Nvidias rapport: "Värderingen under kontroll"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-05-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Lannebo fund manager Johan Nilke reviews Nvidia's quarterly report: revenue rose 85% to $82bn and EPS beat estimates, but the stock dipped because expectations were very high. He argues the valuation is under control at roughly 25-30x earnings, since profits rather than multiple expansion have driven the share price. Minor concerns were raised: China blocking Nvidia chips to favour domestic rivals (Huawei, Alibaba), the large dividend hike possibly signalling fewer growth opportunities, and price pressure on AI tokens from Google TPUs and cheaper Chinese chips.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Lannebo kept Nvidia in its fund. Profits, not multiple expansion, drove the stock, and valuation is ~25-30x forward earnings.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Johan Nilke, Lannebo fund manager) opinion: the report was fundamentally strong (+85% revenue, EPS beat, in-line Q2 guide). Nvidia is one of the few semis in the rally whose gains came from earnings rather than multiple expansion, putting valuation near P/E 25-30 net of cash. The fund kept its position but he declined to recommend buying more. Risks: China blocking chips, large payouts possibly signalling limited reinvestment needs, and customer pushback on the 'Nvidia tax' as token costs

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth rate starts to slow materially
- if customers push back on AI token costs and cheaper alternatives (Google TPU, Chinese chips) take share
- if gross margins compress from memory cost pressure
- if valuation shifts to multiple expansion rather than earnings growth

> *"Vi har behållit Nvidia. Kanske läge att köpa mer? Jag ska inte ge några rekommendationer i tv."*
